qb.fact: Tyson Bagent will start Week 5 at GB. Ben Johnson on ESPN 1000 Monday: 'Tyson will be the guy.' Caleb Williams (Grade 2 hamstring) is out.

QB by week: Williams started W1 and W2 and was hurt in the W2 9-3 loss to MIN. Case Keenum was reported as the W3 MNF starter vs PHI (pre-game reports; Bagent had just cleared concussion protocol). Bagent started W4 (W 23-12 vs NYJ; 25/34, 268 yds, 1 INT). Keenum is the Week 5 backup.
Williams' return window: the Sun-Times says Nov 2 vs SEA is the better bet; RotoBaller says Week 6 vs ATL is possible.

injuries.fact: RB Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe): DNP Wednesday and Thursday. ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports turf toe, which puts Week 5 in doubt. Johnson had earlier said the thumb is 'not an issue'.
RB D'Andre Swift (hip/knee): DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday.

OL Joe Thuney (pectoral), Jonah Jackson (ankle), Darnell Wright (ankle): DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday. LB Keyshaun Elliott (quad): limited Wednesday, DNP Thursday. Kyler Gordon, Grady Jarrett, Noah Sewell, Shemar Turner and Lewis were full Thursday; Gordon, Sewell and Turner are in 21-day IR return windows.

role_news.fact: W4: Monangai had 30 carries, 146 yds, 2 TD; Swift had 15 carries, 58 yds. Johnson called Swift's second-half fumble 'egregious' and denied the benching was injury-related. The Sun-Times says the fumble 'could cost him vs. Packers'.

CHI@GB.fact: Warm and mostly dry. High about 79F (Sun-Times: would tie the hottest GB home Bears game); NFLWeather 73F, 9% rain; Rotogrinders 77F, 5% precip, S wind about 9 mph.

CIN@MIA.fact: Hot and humid, about 89F. Rain chance: 27% (NFLWeather), 8% (Rotogrinders), 15% (MySportsWeather; wind 10 gusting 20). Wind about 10-12 mph. Hurricane Isaias is projected to make landfall on the northern Gulf Coast Fri/Sat, with no direct Miami hit; scattered storms possible; no postponement reported.

LV@NE.fact: NWS: mostly cloudy, high near 64F, showers only after 7 pm. Rain chance: NFLWeather 2%, another listing 10% at 62F, Rotogrinders 28% at 67F. Breeze 10-15 mph increasing in the second half.

CLE@NYJ.fact: Rain chance ranges from 6% (63F) to 56% (Covers; 10 mph) to 89% (meteorologist site; 68F, 8 mph).

IND@PIT.fact: Most sources say rain: 96% chance and locally heavy rain (Weather Channel, via Yahoo); 85% (Indianapolis outlet); 92% at 1 pm, 64F, wind 12 mph. One listing shows 17% at 61F, and a CBS Pittsburgh 'perfect football weather' piece is of uncertain date.

HOU@TEN.fact: Rain chance ranges from 19% (70F, SSW 16 mph) to 41% (67F, possible storm delay) to 87% (71F, gusts about 15 mph). Betting preview: chance of showers, high about 69F.

NYG@WAS.fact: Rain likely, from tropical-system remnants: 92% chance, 64.7F, wind 13.7 mph (Covers). WJLA expects windy and rainy. One summary shows 24% at 67F.
